services.title: We don't sell technology. We design solutions.
services.lead: Every project starts with an assessment and ends with metrics. In between, we build what your business needs.

items.title: Run digitally and grow
items.body: Software, websites and apps built around how your business works, not the other way around.

items.title: More customers, better qualified
items.body: Campaigns on Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok tied to sales funnels you can measure end to end.

items.title: Your business works even when your team doesn't

footer.tagline: Digital transformation for businesses and professionals who want to operate in order and measure results.

results.title: Results you can measure.
results.lead: Every project starts by measuring the starting point, so the result isn't a matter of opinion.
results.companies: businesses and professionals have already transformed how they operate with Exacta.
results.time: less time on manual tasks, in the processes we automate.
results.costs: And in every project, impact metrics agreed during the assessment: costs, time and errors, measured before and after.

method.title: A clear process, predictable results.
method.lead: Six steps, always in the same order. The first one is free.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.body: We analyze your operation, find the bottlenecks and size the potential impact before proposing any solution.

steps.title: Strategy
steps.body: We design the transformation plan around a measurable return. No technology for its own sake: every decision serves a business goal.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.body: We deliver without disrupting your operation, working alongside your team until the solution is up and running.

steps.title: Adoption
steps.body: We train your team to be self-sufficient with the new tools. The transformation has to live inside your business, not depend on us.

steps.title: Optimization
steps.body: We measure, adjust and improve. A transformation doesn't end on launch day: it ends when the numbers confirm it.

steps.title: Shall we start?
steps.body: The first step is always a free assessment session. In 45 minutes we find out whether and how we can help.

products.title: Our own products
products.lead: Besides custom projects, we build products that solve problems for a whole industry. We use them, measure them and improve them every day.
